lesson.title: The paragraph 3 gateway
lesson.summary: Apply the no-significant-risk gateway as well as a listed condition; assess actual influence.

prerequisites.reason: The gateway evaluates a risk of harm, which combines likelihood and severity.
The derogation applies to the Annex III route and cannot be extended to the product route.

blocks: The **paragraph 3 derogation** is a limited departure from Annex III high-risk classification. The system must not pose significant harm risk to health, safety or fundamental rights, including by not materially influencing decision outcomes.
This gateway is not satisfied by an 'administrative' label. Explain the possible harms and influence using the actual system and context.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 6(3), first and second subparagraphs; final subparagraph

blocks: A listed condition must also fit: narrow procedural task, improvement of completed human activity, the specified decision-pattern/review function, or preparation for a relevant assessment.
At least one condition is required; it is not necessary to satisfy all four. But selecting one condition does not remove the gateway. Later lessons test each condition's own wording.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 6(3), first and second subparagraphs; final subparagraph

blocks: **Decision influence** is the role an output plays in what happens to a person. A suggestion can materially shape a decision even when someone signs the final form.

Fictional Northbridge: staff almost always accept an AI shortlist without reassessing excluded applicants. The final human signature does not prove that the output lacks material influence. Investigate the actual review process.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 6(3), first and second subparagraphs; final subparagraph

blocks: The final subparagraph supplies a profiling override for Annex III systems. Keep it in the checklist, alongside documentation and registration if a provider concludes the system is not high-risk.
Our teaching checklist is: listed use; gateway; matching condition; profiling; supporting record. It is an application method, not a new statutory safe harbour or complete set of other-law duties.
